hooks.name: Validate Backend — TypeScript + Property Tests + Terraform
hooks.description: On save of any backend TypeScript or Terraform file: runs tsc --noEmit (hard gate), then fast-check property tests for severity invariants, then terraform fmt -check and terraform validate. Catches type errors and Terraform drift before deployment.

action.command: cd /d "%WORKSPACE_ROOT%" && npm run typecheck && npx jest tests/property --no-coverage --passWithNoTests && cd infra && terraform fmt -check && terraform validate
